color.note: One theme, by design. The site is a dark terminal; there is no light mode to maintain. Every text/ground pair below holds at least 4.5:1 (ink-300 is decorative only).

tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: Page background and the only ground for running text. Blue-black, never pure black.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Raised surface: code blocks, callouts, post cards on hover, the comments panel.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Hover and active fill on bg-100 surfaces; table header rows; the code block's label bar.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and borders on bg-000 (post list rows, footer rule, hr).

tokens.name: line-200
tokens.usage: Borders on bg-100 surfaces and resting outlines of controls (tags, ghost buttons, inputs).

tokens.name: ink-100
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg-000, bg-100 and bg-200. 16:1 on bg-000.

tokens.name: ink-200
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, reading time, captions, footer, the tagline. 8.6:1 on bg-000.

tokens.name: ink-300
tokens.usage: Decorative only: line numbers, disabled controls, the dot grid. 4.4:1 on bg-000, so never for text a reader must read.

tokens.name: cyan-500
tokens.usage: Primary accent. Links, the active nav item, inline code, the prompt glyph, focus rings, every icon. 12:1 on bg-000.

tokens.name: magenta-500
tokens.usage: Secondary accent. Tags, the h2 marker, blockquote rule, text selection ground. 6.7:1 on bg-000; use for short labels, never body copy.

tokens.name: amber-500
tokens.usage: Signal. Warning callouts and the Draft badge. 12.8:1 on bg-000.

tokens.name: red-500
tokens.usage: Danger callouts and removed lines in diffs. 6.5:1 on bg-000. Always paired with a word or icon; never the only cue.

tokens.name: green-500
tokens.usage: Added lines in diffs and success states. 13.6:1 on bg-000. Differs from red-500 in lightness as well as hue.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on cyan-500, magenta-500 or amber-500 fills (primary button, selection, badges). 12.7:1 on cyan-500.

tokens.name: cyan-glow
tokens.usage: 18% cyan halo behind the focus ring and under the active nav item. A glow, never a ground for text.

tokens.name: magenta-glow
tokens.usage: 18% magenta halo for the h1 underline and tag hover. Never a ground for text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Alias used by .nt-prose a. Repoint here if links ever change hue.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Alias used by every :focus-visible ring (2px solid). 12:1 on bg-000, 10:1 on bg-200.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: site-title
styles.usage: The blog name in the header, uppercase. Chakra Petch 700.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Post title. Grows to 42px/48px from 768px (tablet). One per page.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headings in a post; the only heading level most posts need.

styles.name: h3
styles.usage: Sub-sections and post-card titles in the list.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Set the socket's ping interval below the proxy's idle timeout and the drops stop.
styles.usage: Running text on phones. IBM Plex Sans 400, max measure 42rem.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Set the socket's ping interval below the proxy's idle timeout and the drops stop.
styles.usage: Running text from 768px up (tablet and desktop). Same measure.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: A week of chasing a bug that only happened on Tuesdays.
styles.usage: First paragraph of a post, in ink-200. Optional.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Figure captions, footnotes, the footer, callout bodies.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Figure 2. Latency before and after the fix
styles.usage: Image captions and table footers, in ink-200.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks (pre) and inline code. 14px inside tables.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase labels above titles, callout titles, the code block's language label. Prefixed with the prompt glyph > in cyan-500.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Tags, dates in the post list, line numbers, the comment count.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Vertical rhythm in prose is space-5 between paragraphs and space-7 above an h2.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a tag or button.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between tags; padding of a tag; eyebrow-to-title gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding (vertical); callout and code label bar padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The page gutter at every width; card and callout padding; gap between grid children.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Paragraph spacing; padding of the comments panel and code blocks.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Post-card row padding; gap under the post header; gutter on tablet (768px up).

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above every h2; between the article and its comments.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Header-to-content and content-to-footer distance.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of running text: about 68 characters at 17px. Code blocks and figures may break out to 52rem.

tokens.name: measure-wide
tokens.usage: Maximum width of code blocks, tables and figures; also the header and footer.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every tappable thing: nav links, buttons, post-nav cells, tags in a filter list.

radius.note: Square by default. Radius marks the few things that are not part of the page's grid.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default: buttons, code blocks, cards, images, the header. Corners are cut, not rounded.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inline code, badges.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Callouts and the comments panel, so they read as inserted objects rather than page structure.

shadow.note: No drop shadows; depth comes from bg steps. The three glows are the only shadows in the system.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Every :focus-visible. Solid 2px cyan-500 with a soft halo; 12:1 on bg-000.

tokens.name: glow-cyan
tokens.usage: Active nav item, primary button hover.

tokens.name: glow-magenta
tokens.usage: Tag hover and the h1 underline.
